_comment: Was MODIFY_ATTACK on the current attack. A plain STATIC is dispatched by nothing and MODIFY_ATTACK buffs the CURRENT attack, of which there is none when a non-attack action resolves — so this did not merely apply too broadly, it did not run. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is the one-shot: consumed by the first matching attack, expiring with the turn if unused. Ice Bond checks what was PITCHED to play this. The Frostbite token is created under the OPPONENT's control, which is the point of the card.
